After connecting to Wi-Fi, go to advanced settings:

Set
IP Address: Static.
IP Address: 192.168.0.11
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Choose a device name for Wi-Fi
Exit settings.

IP Address: 192.168.0.10
Port: 35000
Click “Save”
4. Start the engine. View vehicle parameters.
